name: Fang Wolf
description: Summon for 12 seconds. Bites a nearby target every 1.8 seconds; then returns to the shrine.

name: Sky Eagle
description: Summon for 18 seconds. Scout enemies, gaps and treasure, with increased coin reach.

name: Mole Digger
description: Summon for 12 seconds. Finds buried rewards through forward progress, not waiting.

name: Ember Fox
description: Summon for 10 seconds. Limited fire support and distance-driven supplies.

name: Stone Turtle
description: Summon for 14 seconds. One guard against a hit; no protection against falling.

name: Astra Dragon
description: One 10-second ultimate per attempt. Up to 15 contact kills while active; bosses resist instant defeat.

skills.name: Dragon Breath
skills.description: For 10 seconds, every enemy kill gives exactly 3× its otherwise-awarded points. Coins and distance are not multiplied.

name: Orca Prince
description: One 12-second ultimate per attempt. Choose a brief clearing flood or water support over gaps.

skills.name: Flood
skills.description: Clear all existing enemies in this map. For 12 seconds, sweep away newly encountered enemies and hostile projectiles, including across endless transitions.

skills.name: Orca Prince
skills.description: For 12 seconds, water supports you across every cliff. Activating while falling lifts you onto the water. Spikes and enemies remain dangerous unless separately protected.

name: Sky Wolf
description: A forged companion. Bites nearby enemies and scouts while flying.

name: Emberguard
description: A forged companion. Fire support and one protective guard.
